description: Next.js 16 App Router, `output: "export"`. No server runtime at request time -- the shipped artifact is out/ (mirrors .next/static under out/_next/static, plus prerendered .html), served with a plain static file server (docs/framework-integration.md §9.2 Next.js row; @afterpack/next's hook.ts module doc for why obfuscating .next/static/chunks in the build hook is what protects the exported tree).

build.note: obfuscation runs INSIDE `next build`, via @afterpack/next's compiler.runAfterProductionCompile hook over .next/static/chunks; the static export then copies those already-obfuscated chunks into out/_next/static

interactions.description: Client island hydrates; counter increments on click.

hydration.note: docs/testing.md §7.4 -- server-rendered (build-time) HTML must agree with the client-hydrated DOM.
